The '''reek''' was a large thick-skinned, horned, rhino-esque quadruped, native to [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. Subspecies could be found on [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. They could also be found on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="swtor">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and in ranches on the [[Codian Moon/Legends|Codian Moon]] and [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:ReekSurfer-SS.png|thumb|left|250px|A Lannik rides with a herd of reeks.]]

The massive [[Bull/Legends|bull]]-like<ref name="Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Scrapbook]]''</ref> Reeks were even-toed ungulates, herbivores by nature, but they were often fed meat for exhibition sport and executions.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> This turned their leathery skin crimson<ref name="CharEnc" /> and made the reeks much more aggressive. Reeks were unable to survive on only meat, so they were given just enough plant matter to keep them healthy.<ref name=":2">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> This method was used by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] for their [[Petranaki arena|Execution Arena]] reeks.

[[File:Rakghoul_Plague_Infected_Reek.png|thumb|right|200px|A reek infected with the [[Rakghoul]] [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]]]]

These stout brutes had tough leathery skin<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|reek|reek}}</ref> which in all reeks, including subspecies, were normally [[Color/Legends|brown]] in color and only changed depending on their diet.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> The mottling identified the subspecies.<ref name=":2" /> Their species could be affected by the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]].<ref name="Pandemic">{{TORcite|World Event: "Rakghoul Pandemic"}}</ref>

Reeks were usually found in herds and resided in the mossy grasslands and were very protective over their chosen area of wood-moss turf.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> They were very protective of their herds, fighting violently with intruders using their horns. Used in displays of dominance in the wild, they could gore opponents, and few would be able to survive a trampling attack from a reek.<ref name="DB" /> They horn-teeth grew continuosly.<ref name=":2" /> Its strong jaws, used to chop tough [[Wood-moss/Legends|wood-moss]] chunks into pieces, could rend flesh and snap [[Bone/Legends|bones]] easily.<ref name="DB" /> They used their front claws for digging up wood-moss and because their cheek horns grew continuously, reeks would rub their horns on trees and rocks to shorten and sharpen them. The horns of male reeks are usually larger than those of females, and they display them to attract a mate. During mating season, male reeks battled each other in ramming contests for the choice females among their herds.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

While reeks were not terribly fast, they were intelligent. If given patient, gentle training, they could make excellent pack animals.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

==Subspecies==
Reeks had been transported to other worlds for various purposes, causing them to adapt to new environments.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

===Iridonian reek===
Another subspecies was the Iridonian reek. Reeks attracted the attention of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] when they developed interstellar travel. They saw reeks as excellent candidates for war mounts. Soon after, they were exported to [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] to be bred. Instead of giving them a meat diet, the Iridonian reeks were given a natural diet consisting of plant matter to keep them fierce and strong with natural vigor, which also turned a reek's skin gray. Adapted to Iridonia, their skin could resist sharp and blunt weapon attacks during battle. The Iridonian reek's horns were much sharper and longer than those of other reeks and were also decorated with tattoos similar to the tattoos a Zabrak was adorned with. Iridonian reeks were encouraged to fight for mates, making them less likely to buck or bolt in battle.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

As the Zabrak advanced, the use of reeks in war declined. However, riding war mounts was still taught in most Iridonian military schools.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

===Ithorian reek===
[[File:Grievousreek.jpg|thumb|left|190px|General Grievous rides a reek on Saleucami.]]
One subspecies, the Ithorian reek, was exported to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. Their yellow skin color was attributed to their diet consisting of yellow flora and [[bafforr tree]]s. They were used as plow animals by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] and were larger and stronger than those found on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. Their horns were also smaller because of the lack of hostility between reeks. Males and females were separated to reduce competition and to isolate mating periods.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

===Kashyyykian reek===
A highly uncommon subspecies was the Kashyyykian reek, also known as a ryyk to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. The majority of reeks on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] died off due to the climate change and the predators, but a select few did survive and learned to thrive. The adaptations required to do so made the Kashyyykian reeks much larger than their cousins. Their horns became narrower, but longer and stronger, and there were one or two examples of the development of poisons beginning to be secreted at the tips.

==History==
{{Quote|Powerful, but stupid|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s thougths upon seeing the reek on Geonosis.|<ref>
[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode II: ''Attack of the Clones'' junior novelization]]</ref>}}
There have been attempts to breed reek for simple, easily-domesticated labor and a source of food and materials. The Codian Moon maintained reek ranches, but scarcer resources had instilled even greater territoriality among those reek. With plummeting profits, unscrupulous ranchers had discovered that the beasts could be starved into carnivorism to provide violent entertainment, and had sold the animals into such cruel endeavors.<ref name="DB" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] some reeks were affected by [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]].<ref name="Pandemic" />
[[File:Reek.jpg|thumb|250x250px|The Reek on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].]]
A wild<ref name=":3">[[Attack of the Clones (Mighty Chronicles)|''Attack of the Clones'' Mighty Chronicles adaptation]]</ref> reek was kept in the [[Petranaki arena|Petranaki Arena]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], in a pen within the walls.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> It stood as tall as a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], as wide as a [[Human/Legends|human]] male was tall, and more than four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.<ref name=":4">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> It was used in the attempted execution of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was observing the scene,<ref name=":0" /> reconized the beast from books he read.<ref name=":5">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref> Anakin, however, tamed<ref name=":0">{{Film|II}}</ref> the surprisingly fast animal<ref name="DB" /> with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and broke his chains before directing it against a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] attacking [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], killing the smaller predator. The reek then separated from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] erupted in the arena,<ref name=":0" /> who abandoned it to its fate.<ref name=":3" /> The reek wanted no part of it, so it ran in wild circles, snarling and snorting, stomping and stamping, crushing droids, [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] troops, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and bystanders under its hooves.<ref name=":5" /> It lost one of its cheek horns to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] before attacking [[Jango Fett]],<ref name=":0" /> unable to distinguish friend from foe.<ref name=":4" /> Though Fett avoided being trampled by the creature and killed it with a single expertly aimed shot to the [[Eye/Legends|eye]], it damaged his [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and led to his own [[Death/Legends|death]] moments later by Windu's blade.<ref name=":0" /> After the battle Boba passed by the dead reek,<ref name=":4" /> still left in the arena,<ref name=":0" /> while searching for his father.<ref name=":4" />

One captured<ref name=":1" /> reek was ridden by [[General]] [[Grievous]], leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]], during the [[battle of Saleucami]].<ref name=" Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>

[[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|Garnac's hunting guild]] killed a reek and placed its head in their [[Ubrikkian Floating Fortress]], alongside the trophies made of other [[Species/Legends|creatures]].<ref name="Wookiee Hunt">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

At some point a group of misguided farmers brought a large reek to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], hoping to develop a new market for the animals as beasts of burden. The plan was a disaster from the start, as the reek was unexpectedly difficult to train, and injured many farmers in the process. After weeks of work, the farmers have barely begun to exert the control they require over the beast. Some local [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] saw the massive creature at the farm and, as already used to riding enormous [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas]], they sent out a raiding party to capture the reek for use as a new. They sprang their attack in broad daylight while the farmers are attempting to guide the beast back to its stall, thougth the reek has ideas of its own.<ref name="Tusken Rustlers">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/tuskenrustlers|text=Tusken Rustlers|int=Tusken Rustlers}}</ref>

The Ithorian reeks were wiped out during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reeks first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name=":0" /> The initial designs of the reek were inspired by [[Wikipedia:Placerias|Placerias]], a stout, four-legged tusked species from the Triassic era. As the designs evolved, it began to take on more bull-like characteristics. Concept sculptor [[Michael Murnane|Michael Patrick Murnane]] was most responsible for developing the reek's final look in a very detailed concept maquette. The creature's tall central horn came out of a specific plot element [[George Lucas]] needed&mdash;Anakin Skywalker was to wrap his chains around the reek's horn when trying to control it.<ref name="DB" /> The digital model for the Reek in Episode 2 was built by [[Derek Gillingham]] at [[Industrial Light & Magic]].<ref name="Derek-Reel">{{WebCite|url=https://vimeo.com/938779619|text=Derek Gillingham Show Reel|author=Derek Gillingham|date=2024-04-24|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/nSmUs}}</ref>

While in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|film]] Jango manages to kill the reek with a single shot to the head,<ref name=":0" /> in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] and the [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|comic adaptation]] the creature is killed by shooting multiple times in the belly.<ref name=":4" /><ref name="Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 4|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 4]]</ref>
